# Vanessa.js.org

> > Personal homepage of Vanessa, a frontend engineer and core member of B3log, showcasing open-source projects and community contributions.

This site serves as the professional portfolio and personal homepage for Vanessa, highlighting involvement with B3log open-source projects including 黑客派 (Hacpai), Pipe, Symphony, Solo, and Wide. The site reflects contributions to Chinese developer communities and blockchain interests.
